content: Shadowing apps (NDTD Language Shadower, Shadowing Language Practice, ShadowEcho) center on audio/video playback controls: loop a segment, variable speed (0.5x-2x), skip back N seconds, synced transcript/subtitles, and record-your-own-voice-alongside-original for comparison. These differ from reflex-drill apps in that the core mechanic is repeat-after-source rather than respond-to-prompt; countdown-before-record is not a common pattern here since shadowing is play-along, not think-then-speak. Confirms record+playback+history is the baseline expectation across this whole app category.
